name: mirage
text:
v1.0.13 is released:
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.13
It has: API status lights fixed (pinnapi with refused keys is red, PinnWire lit), a 'X is working again' message, your chat draft kept when you switch tabs, Kalshi slips saying Kalshi, closing at the tap and starting at the minimum contract, and Kalshi notifications for bets placed, bids filled and failed or timed-out orders.
